scenes.name: YOU WAKE UP
scenes.desc: Morning. An extreme close-up of a young person's eyes opening in bed, lit by a phone screen. The phone: 07:12, "No notifications". They go to the bedroom window of their 12th-floor flat: the camera starts on their face and pulls back over their shoulder to reveal the city below - empty avenues, cars stopped where they were left, no people, no movement.
scenes.actions: The main character (the only character in the film): young adult, short dark hair, olive hoodie, jeans, white trainers. Sleepy -> puzzled -> uneasy. Thumb scrolls the phone; walks to the window; hand on the glass.
scenes.lighting: Cool grey-blue morning light through the window; the phone's glow on the face in the first shot.
scenes.sfx: Quiet room tone, a fridge hum, a single phone buzz that turns out to be nothing; distant birds; no traffic.
scenes.edit: Hard cut from the eyes to the phone; slow pull-back on the window shot. Title: YOU ARE THE LAST HUMAN ON EARTH.

shots.name: eyes
shots.camera: extreme close-up of the eyes, slow push-out and drift; eyes open

shots.name: phone
shots.camera: over-the-shoulder insert of the phone screen, slight drift; shallow focus

shots.name: window
shots.camera: starts close on the face at the window, pulls back and arcs over the shoulder to reveal the empty avenue 36 m below

scenes.name: THE WORLD IS YOURS
scenes.desc: Freedom. They walk down the middle of the empty avenue, past abandoned cars. A supermarket with abandoned trolleys - they help themselves. A cinema: they sit alone in the middle of the empty rows, the film still playing. A shopping mall: they ride the escalator, which still runs. A deserted city square: they spin with their arms out as pigeons take off.
scenes.actions: Unsure at first, then grinning; takes an apple, puts their feet up in the cinema, spins in the square.
scenes.lighting: Bright, warm morning sun; clean fluorescent supermarket; projector light in the dark cinema; skylight in the mall.
scenes.sfx: Footsteps that echo, a shop's automatic door, fridges humming, film soundtrack bleeding from the screen, escalator hum, pigeons' wings; light, rising music.
scenes.edit: Fast, energetic cuts on the beat. Key caption: THE ENTIRE WORLD IS YOURS.

scenes.name: SOMETHING IS WRONG
scenes.desc: Afternoon to dusk. A traffic light changes from red to green over an empty junction. A commuter train waits at a platform with its doors open and its lights on. A neighbour's home: lights and TV still on, dinner on the table, nobody there - the character looks in from outside. Sunset over the skyline. Then, from the flat's window, districts of the city go dark one after another while others stay lit.
scenes.actions: Walking more slowly; looking into the train; face at the neighbour's window; standing at their own window as the lights go out.
scenes.lighting: Flat afternoon light, then a warm low sunset, then blue dusk with the city's windows lit, then patches of darkness.
scenes.sfx: The music drops away. Traffic-light relay click and the ticking of a crossing signal, the train's idling compressor, a TV muffled behind glass, a low electrical hum that dies district by district.
scenes.edit: Slower cuts. Key caption: BUT SOMETHING IS WRONG.

scenes.name: THE SILENCE
scenes.desc: Night. The character sits alone at the kitchen table by candlelight and looks at an old photograph of friends. Then the empty street: streetlights still on in this district, wind pushing sheets of paper across the road. A deserted playground: an empty swing moving in the wind beside them. Finally a tiny figure walking alone beneath the dark towers.
scenes.actions: Still and quiet: thumb on the photo; hands in pockets; sitting on a swing; walking slowly.
scenes.lighting: Candle and moonlight in the kitchen; sodium/LED streetlights; a single lamp at the playground; moonlit clouds over the towers.
scenes.sfx: Music almost gone. Candle flicker, a clock ticking, wind, paper scraping across asphalt, a creaking swing chain, footsteps.
scenes.edit: Long shots; two full seconds without narration. Key caption: YOU ARE COMPLETELY ALONE.

scenes.name: THE BIG REALISATION
scenes.desc: Dawn. The roof door of the character's tower opens onto blinding morning light. A huge aerial shot pulls away from the lone figure at the parapet to reveal the whole empty city in the mist: no traffic, no crowds, no voices. Then the figure, small against the sunrise.
scenes.actions: Pushes the door open, walks to the parapet, looks across the horizon.
scenes.lighting: Low golden sun behind the skyline, haze and long shadows.
scenes.sfx: A door's latch and creak, strong wind on the roof, distant birds; a slow, wide swell of strings.

shots.name: roofdoor
shots.camera: from the roof, low; the door opens toward camera, light floods in

shots.name: aerial
shots.camera: drone-style pull back and up from the figure to the whole city

shots.name: edge
shots.camera: behind and to the side of the figure at the parapet, slow drift

scenes.name: THE FINAL PAYOFF
scenes.desc: On the roof: they take out their phone one last time - "No service", "No new messages". They put it away and look toward the empty horizon. The film ends on an extreme close-up of their eyes closing, mirroring the first shot, so it loops.
scenes.actions: Looks at the phone, lowers it, slides it into the hoodie pocket; a long look; eyes close.
scenes.lighting: Warm dawn light on one side of the face, cool shadow on the other.
scenes.sfx: Wind; a soft piano figure; the music fades to nothing on the last line, leaving only the wind.
scenes.edit: Slow push-ins; fade to black on the last frame (the first frame is the same eyes, so the Short loops).

lines.text: You wake up. No calls. No messages.
lines.tts: You wake up. No calls. No messages.

lines.text: The city outside is silent. Everyone is gone.
lines.tts: The city outside is silent. Everyone is gone.

lines.text: Every road is yours. Every shop. Every seat in the cinema.
lines.tts: Every road is yours. Every shop. Every seat in the cinema.

lines.text: Traffic lights change for no one. Trains wait at empty platforms.
lines.tts: Traffic lights change for no one. Trains wait at empty platforms.

lines.text: Machines can run on their own for a while. But power grids need people, day and night.
lines.tts: Machines can run on their own for a while. But power grids need people, day and night.

lines.text: Sooner or later, the lights start going out.
lines.tts: Sooner or later, the lights start going out.

lines.text: That night, you finally hear it. The silence.
lines.tts: That night, you finally hear it. The silence.

lines.text: Over 8 billion voices, gone. Just your footsteps, and the wind.
lines.tts: Over eight billion voices, gone. Just your footsteps, and the wind.

lines.text: From up here, a whole city belongs to you. A whole planet.
lines.tts: From up here, a whole city belongs to you. A whole planet.

lines.text: And nobody to share it with.
lines.tts: And nobody to share it with.

lines.text: The strangest part wouldn't be having the world to yourself. It would be realising there's nobody left to tell.
lines.tts: The strangest part wouldn't be having the world to yourself. It would be realising there's nobody left to tell.
